stories.headline: Product Design in 2026: The Beginning of a Fantastic Voyage
stories.dek: Designers are navigating a fundamental shift as AI reshapes creative workflows, design systems evolve into governance platforms, and spatial interfaces demand new mental models beyond the screen.

stories.headline: State of UX 2026: Design Deeper to Differentiate
stories.dek: Nielsen Norman Group's annual review finds that surface-level AI adoption is no longer a differentiator — teams that win are building with deeper systems thinking, inclusive design, and measurable user outcomes.

stories.headline: 12 Product Design Trends Defining 2026
stories.dek: From AI-generated component variants to sonic design systems and the comeback of evolved glassmorphism, product design in 2026 is as much about governance and accessibility as aesthetics.

stories.headline: 10 UX/UI Design Trends Shaping 2026
stories.dek: Multi-modal interfaces, accessibility-as-competitive-advantage, and dimensional design for spatial computing are reshaping how product teams think about every interaction touchpoint.

stories.headline: UX Research Methods: The Complete 2026 Guide
stories.dek: AI is accelerating analysis of usability data at scale, but moderated testing remains the gold standard for understanding both what users do and why — a combination no automated tool yet replaces.

stories.headline: 8 Usability Testing Methods That Work in 2026
stories.dek: Contentsquare's updated guide covers the full spectrum from moderated sessions to tree testing, with new guidance on accessibility testing as a first-class research activity amid expanding global compliance requirements.

stories.headline: 10 Essential UX Research Tools for 2026
stories.dek: Qualtrics maps the evolving toolkit for UX teams, from AI-assisted synthesis platforms to large-panel remote testing services, as research operations mature into a strategic function within product organizations.

stories.headline: Microsoft Launches Agent 365: An Enterprise Governance Layer for AI Agents
stories.dek: Microsoft's new $15/user/month product separates AI governance and security controls from Copilot, signaling that enterprise AI management is itself becoming a product category.

stories.headline: OpenAI Brings GPT-5.5 and Codex to Amazon Bedrock
stories.dek: OpenAI's frontier models are now available on AWS infrastructure, giving enterprises familiar governance workflows while accessing the latest agentic coding and computer-use capabilities.

stories.headline: New AI Tools — May 2026: GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Ultra All Ship This Month
stories.dek: The AI race has shifted from demo performance to model cost, compute access, and device control — all three frontier labs ship agentic capabilities as core features, not add-ons.

stories.headline: AI Model Release Tracker: May 2026
stories.dek: A live tracker of major model releases and capability updates across providers, capturing how rapidly the frontier is moving as multiple labs ship production-grade agentic systems in the same month.

stories.headline: New Algorithm Slashes AI Energy Use by 100× While Improving Accuracy
stories.dek: Researchers combined neural networks with symbolic reasoning in a hybrid approach that dramatically cuts compute requirements — a potentially transformative development for deploying AI at scale in energy-constrained environments.

stories.headline: 10 Things That Matter in AI Right Now
stories.dek: MIT Technology Review finds AI agent success rates leaping from 20% to 77% in one year, generative AI value to US consumers hitting $172B annually, and mechanistic interpretability emerging as a critical research priority.

stories.headline: Inside the AI Index: 12 Takeaways from Stanford's 2026 Report
stories.dek: Stanford HAI's comprehensive annual index documents the rapid industrialization of AI — from research benchmarks to real-world deployment — with detailed analysis of safety, labor market effects, and geopolitical competition.

stories.headline: NVIDIA Pushes Physical AI Forward with New Isaac GR00T Open Models
stories.dek: New open models enable robots to understand natural language and execute complex multistep tasks using vision-language-action reasoning, accelerating the path to deployable autonomous physical systems.

stories.headline: IoT in 2026: The Technologies Driving the Next Wave of Growth
stories.dek: Vision-as-a-service, wearable sensor textiles, and dual cellular/LoRaWAN deployments are reshaping the IoT hardware landscape as device makers treat local AI inference as a competitive differentiator.

stories.headline: 6 IoT Semiconductor Predictions for 2026
stories.dek: IoT Analytics forecasts that chips optimized for edge AI inference will dominate new silicon projects, as the predictive maintenance market approaches $28B and industrial deployments demand real-time local processing.

stories.headline: AT&T Unveils IoT Network Intelligence at CES 2026
stories.dek: AT&T's new platform brings AI-powered anomaly detection and adaptive routing to cellular IoT deployments, addressing reliability and latency concerns as industrial and critical-infrastructure applications scale.

stories.headline: Industrial IoT in 2026: Applications, Platforms, and Business Value
stories.dek: IIoT now accounts for the largest share of IoT market growth, with connected sensors and AI-driven analytics delivering measurable ROI across manufacturing quality control, supply chain visibility, and energy management.

stories.headline: AIoT in 2026: From Edge Intelligence to Agentic Systems
stories.dek: LLM-powered agents now enable natural-language commands to security cameras, energy systems, and industrial equipment, transforming how humans interact with connected infrastructure beyond simple reactive automation.

stories.headline: Top 5 AIoT Trends in 2026
stories.dek: Hikvision's industry overview spotlights LLM-integrated smart cameras, conservation IoT for wildlife monitoring, and the $102B global AIoT market as AI and IoT continue their convergence into unified intelligent systems.

stories.headline: IoT and AI in 2026: Market Scale, Architecture, and Industry Impact
stories.dek: North America holds 41.6% of the AIoT market while Asia-Pacific grows at 23% CAGR, as edge computing architectures become the backbone of real-time intelligent systems across healthcare, energy, and smart cities.

stories.headline: How Smart AIoT Systems Are Redefining Business in 2026
stories.dek: From traffic management to energy grid optimization and public safety, AIoT is moving beyond pilot programs into operational infrastructure — with edge intelligence enabling millisecond response times and on-premises privacy.

stories.headline: IoT in Agriculture: The 2026 Smart Farming Guide
stories.dek: Precision IoT farming in 2026 is solar-powered, edge-processed, and tied to carbon-credit programs — smart irrigation is demonstrating 30% water reduction while AI-driven soil monitoring opens new revenue streams.

stories.headline: Top 7 Smart Farming IoT Innovations for 2026
stories.dek: The convergence of satellite imagery, IoT soil sensors, and AI crop modeling is enabling smallholder farmers to access precision agriculture tools previously available only to large agribusinesses.

stories.headline: IoT and 5G Advance Precision Farming and Sustainability
stories.dek: New research shows IoT-integrated 5G networks cutting agricultural energy consumption by up to 25% while enabling real-time crop monitoring at previously impossible sensor densities.

stories.headline: Advancing Agriculture Through IoT, Big Data, and AI: A Sustainability Review
stories.dek: Integrated IoT-AI-big-data systems are enabling sustainable agriculture at scale, with soil carbon monitoring, autonomous pest detection, and water optimization identified as the highest-impact current applications.

stories.headline: Product Designer Jobs in Spain Surge in May 2026
stories.dek: Spain's product design market now has 300+ active openings in Barcelona alone, with Figma expertise, accessibility skills, and design systems experience leading demand for senior-level roles.

stories.headline: PandaDoc Hiring Senior Product Designer for Core UX & Mobile (Remote)
stories.dek: The remote-friendly EU role focuses on core product UX and mobile experience, requiring strong systems thinking and cross-functional collaboration — one of several senior design roles actively hiring across Europe.

stories.headline: Barcelona's Design Job Market: Active Product, UX, and Research Roles
stories.dek: Barcelona's aggregated design job market shows healthy demand for senior ICs and design leads at established companies and growth-stage startups, with 2-sided platform experience and research skills commanding premium compensation.

stories.headline: Design Jobs in Spain: UX, Product Design, and Research Openings
stories.dek: A curated board of active design roles across Spain highlights growing demand for UX researchers and senior product designers, particularly at companies building B2B SaaS and fintech products for European markets.

stories.headline: Seven Technologies to Watch in 2026: From Quantum Computing to mRNA Therapeutics
stories.dek: Nature's annual outlook highlights quantum error correction, AI-powered climate modelling, and mRNA-based cancer treatments as the most consequential near-term advances with broad societal implications.

stories.headline: Chinese Court Rules Companies Cannot Lay Off Workers on AI Grounds
stories.dek: A landmark ruling signals that governments worldwide are beginning to set hard legal limits on AI-driven workforce displacement, with significant implications for how enterprises deploy automation at scale.

stories.headline: 4 Tech Trends Shaping 2026 and the Breakthroughs Powering Them
stories.dek: AI is becoming invisible infrastructure — embedded in spreadsheets, customer systems, and internal platforms — as enterprises shift focus from frontier model demos to measurable ROI from deployed agents.

stories.headline: Tech Trends 2026: 5 Forces Shaping the Future
stories.dek: Globant's annual report identifies AI agents, quantum computing accessibility, green tech industrialization, spatial computing, and biosystems integration as the five macro forces redefining business and society in 2026.
